headline: Taiwan Stocks Soar 40% in Two Months, Déjà Vu? Not Feeling the Crisis Is Terrifying? Veteran Manager Reveals the Crazy 'Taiwan Money Floods In' History from 38 Years Ago - Finance
summary: The Taiex rose from about 31,000 to nearly 45,000 points between late March and late May, gaining over 40% in two months, a veteran fund manager said.
why: The Taiwan Capitalization Weighted Stock Index tracks major Taiwanese listed companies, many of them semiconductor and electronics makers.
why_moved: The article reports the index rise from late March to late May and compares it with a similar 1988 rally; it does not state a single cause.
